mechanism: Both drugs are renally eliminated and amoxicillin may compete with captopril for renal tubular secretion, potentially increasing captopril levels; additionally, amoxicillin-induced hypersensitivity reactions can occur concomitantly with ACE inhibitors which may increase angioedema risk.
action: Monitor renal function and blood pressure; counsel patient on signs of angioedema; ensure adequate hydration; consider renal dose adjustments if eGFR significantly reduced.
